summary: Module 02 is edited into one module. node tools/check.mjs --module 2 --lang en --words reports 0 errors and 2 warnings, both expected: 18 figures are not drawn yet, and the mlp-playground widget is not built yet. The session-ref warnings (#p1, #p2, #p3, #what_goes_wrong) and the false 'link target not found: Xtr' are gone. The concept prose is 17,824 words against a plan target of 15,850 (s1 2058, s2 1142, s3 1391, s4 1412, s5 1106, s6 1249, s7 1299, s8 1263, s9 1155, s10 1256, s11 1412, s12 1054, s13 620, s14 1407). Nothing was shortened, so the total is still 824 words above BRIEF's ceiling of 17,000; s1 alone is 57% over its target. 18 of the 21 figures are kept: fig-02-1 to fig-02-13, 15, 17, 18, 20 and 21. All five labs report ALL LABS MATCH after the code changes in Labs 2 and 5. The plan JSON's display fields are polished, the file is still valid JSON, and every activity ref resolves.
changes: Fixed a corrupted escape the checker missed: 21-labs-b.md (Lab 4, step 1) had a tab character followed by 'imes' where '\times' belonged, in '$4 \times 359 = 1{,}436$'. The earlier KaTeX errors in 20-labs-a.md (lines 131 and 1214) had already been repaired before this pass, and a scan of all seven parts finds no other control characters.

Lab 3 numbers carried into Sections 7-9 and What goes wrong (the plan's predictions were replaced by real outputs). Section 7: SGD 0.5 and momentum reach a training loss below 0.1 by epochs 3 and 4. Section 8: at Adam's first step, 615 parameters have zero gradient (512 first-layer weights from the four constant pixels and 103 second-layer weights), the non-zero gradients run from 1.8e-7 to 6.4e-2, and 99.96% of parameters move by more than 0.99 eta. Section 9's noise floor: constant 0.0130 (26% above the 0.0104 floor, standard deviation over the last five epochs 0.0007), step decay 0.01041, cosine 0.01043. Section 9's range test: SGD 0.048 / 0.44 / stopped at 0.58; Adam 2.4e-3 / 0.017 / stopped at 0.089; the chosen peaks are about nine times below the minima. What goes wrong now says 0.0130.

Lab 4 numbers carried into Sections 11 and 14 and What goes wrong. Early stopping: best epoch 34 (0.1159), stop at epoch 49. Fig-02-18's caption now gives best epoch 34 and a patience window of epochs 35-49. Section 14 now gives the per-layer monitoring (activation standard deviation, last-step gradient norms 0.29/0.35/0.43 to 0.015/0.010/0.020), the update ratios (about 1e-2, 1.5-1.8e-3, 2.3-2.6e-4) and the seed spread, 97.28% +/- 0.36.

Recomputed Section 11's temperature-scaling worked example on the real Lab 4 checkpoint, in the lab environment, because the plan's figures (T = 1.20, NLL 0.134) came from a different run. Plain model: T = 1.27, test NLL 0.148 to 0.132, ECE (15 bins) 0.019 to 0.018, accuracy 96.9%. With label smoothing: mean top probability 0.864, accuracy 98.1%, ECE 0.117 to 0.015, T = 0.49, NLL 0.178 to 0.061. A 1.1-point gap is 1.2 standard errors. The section now says where these numbers come from.
Lab 5 numbers in What goes wrong: the gradient norm grows from 7 to 195, and the evaluations give 94.2% / 93.6% / 85.5% against 96.9%.

Figures: three were removed. Fig-02-14 repeated the two-weight worked example as a line plot; its worked example now states the proportionality instead. Fig-02-16 repeated Lab 3's range-test plot. Fig-02-19 repeated the floating-point table. Fig-02-11 (the momentum paths) is moved ahead of fig-02-12 so that the numbering follows the reading order. Text references were added for figures 2.1-2.6, 2.8, 2.10, 2.11, 2.15, 2.18, 2.20 and 2.21.

One symbol per quantity. The finite-difference step is now epsilon_fd in Section 3's check, in Lab 1's prose (the code keeps eps) and in Exercise 13, as in Section 14. Adam's constant is \epsilon in Exercises 5 and 8, as in Section 8. The Huber threshold is delta_H, which keeps delta for the error signal. Lab 3's noise variable is xi. Exercise 7 now notes that its velocity convention is Section 7's rescaled by -eta, with the same iterates and limits.

Cross-references fixed. Lab 1 step 6 sent the reader to a 'loop of Section 1' that does not exist; it now points to Module 01, Section 3. Lab 1 step 1 now names Section 3's code correctly. Lab 3 step 7 now points to Section 9 for warmup, not Section 8. Lab 5 step 6 claimed to run 'the first four items' of the checklist; it now says items 3 and 4, and the docstring no longer claims a gradient-flow test. Bare Module 01 links now carry section anchors (s3, s6, s7, s10, s12).

Public-site and voice hygiene. Section 13 no longer says 'the source's loop'. Lab 4 step 5 no longer says 'as the task asks'. Lab 5's goal no longer calls itself 'the healthy script of Lab 4', and its runtime is stated as at most about two minutes.

Lab code. Lab 2 printed wall-clock times that changed between runs (16 s against 31 s, 0.2 s against 0.3 s per step); it now prints stable thresholds and the ratio as a power of ten, and the prose says so. In Lab 5, model[0](Xtr) became first_layer(Xtr), because the checker misread it as a Markdown link. Both labs were re-run with labrun --update, and a full run of all five labs then matched, apart from the two Lab 2 timing lines that this change removed.

Practice part. The quiz's KaTeX typo \sqrt{1-\beta_2^t)} is fixed. The quiz time is now 18 minutes, matching the study plan. The summary is cut from 13 bullets to 12, as SPEC allows, by merging the two backpropagation bullets. The schedule/range-test/clipping bullet, which paired each tool with the wrong protection, is rewritten.

Plan JSON (display fields only; still valid, indent 1). The lead is one sentence. The prerequisites, outcomes and software are written as sentences, with the maths in $...$ ($L$-layer, delta = p-hat - y, 10^{-6}, 1/(1-p), ln softmax(z), L_2). The session titles are kept. Every activity's 'what' is rewritten in Module 01's style. The refs p1/p2/p3 now point to 'reading' and what_goes_wrong to 'wrong'. The study plan totals 618 minutes.
issues: The concept prose is 17,824 words, above BRIEF's 13,000-17,000 range and the plan's 15,850. s1 (2,058 against 1,300) is the main excess. Nothing was cut, because this pass must not shorten. A later decision should either trim s1, for example the playground-in-numbers or the sawtooth table, or accept the overrun, as Module 01 did.

The plan's non-display fields (what_goes_wrong, writer_notes, the section worked examples) still quote the pre-execution numbers: 0.0122, 786, 0.055/0.29/0.77, 2.3e-3/0.059, 97.39 +/- 0.32, epochs 29/44, T = 1.20, 7 to 194, and 92.2/93.0/84.4/96.7. Lab 4's calibration extension (Try this, item 2) is not executed on the page. Section 11's temperature-scaling numbers come from a scratch run of Lab 4's code plus that extension (scratchpad/m02edit/temp_scaling.py), not from a page lab block. The ECE is noisy on 360 images: with 10 bins instead of 15 the plain model's ECE moves from 0.017 to 0.005.
Lab 5's extensions E-G and Lab 4's other extensions remain described, not run, as the writers reported.
Lab 2 still prints the engine-to-PyTorch speed ratio rounded to a power of ten, which could flip between 1,000 and 10,000 on a very different machine.

Exercise 13(c) quotes per-entry errors 'between 0.29 and 1.00' for the broken backward pass. Lab 1 prints only the worst entries (0.38 and 1.0), so the 0.29 lower bound is not checkable from the page.

Lambda without a subscript is used for a curvature in Section 7's heavy-ball analysis and in Section 9's noise-floor formula, as well as for weight decay in Section 8. They never share an equation, and the noise-floor form follows Module 01, so it was left as it is.

Some numbers in Lab 1's neo-Hookean extension (c_1 = 0.5 MPa, stretches 0.6-1.0) are a suggested set-up that Module 01 does not state. Module 01, Section 12 fits a hydrogel coefficient to its own data.
